plugins.description: Plan, sequence, deliver and hand off work using consumer policy and gh-steward for GitHub composition.

interface.longDescription: Reusable project planning, backlog governance, queue and relationship guidance. GitHub composition uses gh-steward; ordinary lifecycle operations use the available client connector or native GitHub CLI under repository policy. Plugin-owned dependency, documentation, governance, merge-review and release-preparation agents use native install and upgrade consent.
defaultPrompt: Use the project's own policy for portable planning, governance, and delivery.
Use gh-steward for composed GitHub planning; use native gh or an existing connector for ordinary GitHub operations.
